toolchain.developmentCompiler: Kamek plus NXP CodeWarrior Special Edition for MPC55xx/MPC56xx v2.10
toolchain.decision: Compile in a trusted release environment and distribute only reviewed artifacts. End users never install a compiler or CodeWarrior.

releaseGates: Provision a reviewed clean RMBE01 Rev 0 fingerprint from a lawful dump.
Select and document a clean-room hook site and its exact original bytes.
Insert and verify the required PowerPC cache and ordering barriers.
Compile the bridge in the trusted toolchain and review exported symbols.
Boot the patched build and complete the nonce/event test in pinned Dolphin.
